name: Wizarr Requests
overview: Request access, review profiles, and approve single-use Wizarr invitations.
description: Preview: a browser profile wizard and administrator-only approval queue. Requires Jellyfin 12.2.0 and Wizarr's invitation API. Requests are disabled until configured.

versions.changelog: Keep ordinary Jellyfin-to-Seerr links in the current tab while signing in through native Quick Connect. Updated companion supports same-tab Play on Jellyfin links with an optional small HTML adapter. Explicit modifier-clicks retain browser behavior; versioned assets avoid stale companion scripts.

Optional browser sign-in for external Seerr links via native Jellyfin Quick Connect. Requires File Transformation and the static Seerr companion. Strict origin/tab/nonce checks; no bearer token in links or server forks. Existing Seerr cleanup and request data preserved.

Optional Seerr account cleanup on native Jellyfin user deletion, exact Jellyfin ID matching, owner protection and persistent retries. Seerr deletion also removes associated request records. Disabled until configured.

Simpler name-and-note request form, two-step review, optional URL-encoded username prefill for compatible Wizarr installations. Existing requests and private status links are preserved. Wizarr email/password policies are managed separately.
First public preview. Profile requests, private status links, administrator approval/decline, single-use seven-day Wizarr invitations. No email/push delivery or native Helmarr approval queue.
